translations.text: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord of lords says to Edom: We have heard news from the LORD, and a messenger has been sent to the nations: “Rise up! Let us rise against her for battle!”
Look, I have made you small among the nations, and you are greatly despised.
The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who live in the stronghold of the rock, whose dwelling is high, and who say in your heart, “Who can bring me down to the ground?”
Even if you rise as high as an eagle, and even if you set your nest among the stars, I will bring you down from there, says the LORD.
If thieves came upon you, or robbers by night, how could you remain silent until they had stolen their fill? And if grape gatherers came upon you, would they not leave some gleanings?
How Esau has been searched out, and his hidden treasures uncovered!

All your allies have sent you to the border. They have deceived you and exhausted your strength. Those at peace with you, who share your bread, have laid an ambush beneath you. There is no understanding in him.
On that day, says the LORD, I will destroy the wise from Edom and those with understanding from the mountain of Esau.
Your warriors will be plundered, Teman, and the people of the mountain of Esau will perish by slaughter.
Because of your violence against your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will perish forever.
On the day when you stood against him, on the day when foreigners took his wealth captive and strangers entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, you too were like one of them.
Do not look on at your brother’s day, the day of foreigners. Do not rejoice over the people of Judah on the day of their destruction, and do not boast on the day of distress.
Do not enter the gate of my people on the day of their trouble. Do not rejoice over his misfortune on the day of his trouble, and do not strip him of his wealth on the day of his trouble.
And do not stand at the crossroads to destroy his fugitives, and do not hand over his survivors on the day of distress.
For the day of the LORD is near against all the nations. As you have done, so it will be done to you; your repayment will return upon your own head.
For just as you drank on my holy mountain, all the nations will drink continually. They will drink, become dazed, and stagger, and they will be as though they had never existed.
But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will take possession of those who took possession of them.

The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau stubble. They will set them on fire and consume them, and no survivor will remain of the house of Esau, for the LORD has spoken.

Those of the south will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the plain will possess the Philistines. They will possess the fields of Ephraim and the fields of Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.
This first group of exiles of the Israelites, from Canaan as far as Zarephath, and the exiles of Jerusalem who are in Spain, will possess the cities of the south.
Those who have been delivered will go up to Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau, and the kingdom will belong to the LORD.
